description:
Blazing-fast Claude in your terminal — a C++26 alternative to claude-code.

agentty is a native C++26 terminal coding agent and a drop-in alternative to claude-code. A single static binary with sub-millisecond cold start, sandboxed by default, and one-command SSH air-gap. No Node, Python, or Electron. Signs in with your Claude Pro/Max subscription or an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
Changed
- The provider picker (Ctrl+P) shows what you have set up instead of
  the whole catalogue. The rest collapse behind one "Show N more
  providers" line; press Enter on it or Ctrl+E to reveal them. Typing
  still searches every provider.
- A provider with more than one account says which one is serving, on
  the model picker's section header and the status badge.
- RECENT in the model picker is ordered by recency. It used to be
  alphabetical, so the model you picked moments ago could sit below one
  you last used a week back.
Fixed
- Changing model no longer renames every turn already in the thread
  (#120). A turn's header named whichever model was selected rather
  than the one that produced it. Turns recorded before this release
  still show the selection.
- Switching account on the active provider reloads its model list,
  which matters when two accounts have different entitlements.
- Keys in the provider picker no longer appear to need two presses.
- The @ and # pickers show their keys; Enter, Esc and the arrows
  always worked, nothing said so.
- Settings > Plugins shows edit and remove on an unapproved server.
- Footer hints describe the highlighted row: Ctrl+F reads unfavorite on
  a model you have starred, and Ctrl+/ reads "all providers" when the
  list is scoped to one.
Full history: CHANGELOG.md
